title: ci xóotaayu bënn bi
intro: Tukkib ruuh bu ndaw tàmbali ci gis-gis bu am doole buy wane mbindéef yu asamaan yuy sukku ngir sargal ko. Dundug nit ki bariwoon na ay wor yu metti yu bawoo ci ñi mu gëna jege, ci la ñu ko jàppee jaam ay at ci ginaaw, ñu jàpp ko tëj ko te jagul dara. Waaye ndax ngëm gu dëggu gi ak ndigalu Yàlla, nit kooku jog na ci pax mi gëna suufe, nekk kenn ci nit ñi gëna am doole ci empire bu mag. Ndax mën nga wane kan mooy jaamu Yàlla bu yéeme bii?
clues: Ñu wane ma fukk ak benn biddiiw, jant bi ak weer wi ñuy sujju ci sama kanam
Man maay doom ji samay waajur bëgg lool, te loolu moo jur fiiraange ci samay rak
Samay rak jàpp nañu ma, summi sama yéere, sànni ma ci bënn bu xóot te lëndëm
Dañu ma jaay ci marse, yóbbu ma fu sori ci sama réew.
Benn jigéen bu am doole dafa jéemoon nax sama ngor, ñu jàpp ma ndax bëgguma ko wax
Dañu ma barkeel ci may tekki gént, ma joge ci kaso buñu fatte dem ba nekk njiitu réewum Egypt.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
